records.notes: Published in Blizzard's WoW Forever Beta development notes; the notes describe the beta client. Whether the release client matches, and the in-game effective date and build, are not verified. The post was edited later (last edit 2026-10-26); its race entries are dated by the post's creation.

set.description: Reduces the Mana, Rage or Energy cost of your next 3 spells or abilities by 10% and increases their damage or healing by 10%.

ops.summary: Clarified as a 10% discount on Mana, Rage or Energy abilities for every class.

previous.description: Reduces the cost of your next 3 spells or abilities and increases their damage or healing by 10%.

details: Each herb needs a player level equal to the level required to pick it divided by 5. Herbs that need more than 300 Herbalism skill can be cultivated at player level 60.

ops.summary: Cultivating a herb now needs a minimum player level.

details: Does not break crowd control and only triggers from spells and abilities that have a damage component: Shadow Word: Pain triggers it on cast but not on periodic damage.

ops.summary: No longer breaks crowd control, and only triggers from effects that deal damage.
